description: Medida calculada (campo calculado da dinâmica) depois do agrupamento.
sql:
WITH "n1" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Vendas.parquet')
), "n2" AS (
  SELECT
    "ativo",
    CAST(SUM("quantidade") AS BIGINT) AS "qtd",
    ROUND(
      CAST(CASE
        WHEN CAST(SUM("quantidade") AS BIGINT) = 0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(CAST(SUM("valor") AS DOUBLE) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(SUM("quantidade") AS BIGINT)
      END AS DOUBLE),
      2
    ) AS "ticket"
  FROM "n1"
  GROUP BY
    "ativo"
), "n3" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM "n2"
  ORDER BY
    "ativo" DESC
)
SELECT
  *
FROM "n3"
